node.statement: Let R be a right inverse of U, whose existence is part of U in calU, so U bold-dot R=J. Approximate associativity and exact unitality give ||U^dagger-R||=||U^dagger bold-dot(U bold-dot R)-(U^dagger bold-dot U) bold-dot R||<=4*epsilon*||R||. Hence (1-4*epsilon)||R||<=||U^dagger||<=2; since epsilon<1/200, ||R||<3 and ||U^dagger-R||<12*epsilon.
